title: Tor comparison for flat scalar extension
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings in one universe and f : R → S a flat ring homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For every R-module L, S-module N, and natural i, there is an R-linear isomorphism Res_f(Tor_i^S(Ext_f L,N)) ≅ Tor_i^R(L,Res_f N), with extension and restriction of scalars [def-weil-module-base-change] and Tor [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. No finite generation or nonzero hypothesis is imposed.

source.document: C. Weibel, An Introduction to Homological Algebra
source.place: Corollary 4.3.6 and Theorem 4.3.7, pp. 101–102; https://math.mit.edu/~hrm/palestine/weibel/04-homological_dimension.pdf; source read online, including the proof of sequence (*)

proof.text: Take Mathlib projectiveResolution L. Flatness gives preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat. Extension is additive by extendRestrictScalarsAdj.left_adjoint_additive and preserves projective objects by preservesProjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesEpimorphisms, since restriction is exact. Mathlib mapProjectiveResolution therefore extends this resolution to a projective resolution of Ext_f L.

For each term P_j, compose restriction of the S-tensor braiding, exists_tensorRestrictExtend_module_natural at (N,P_j), and the R-tensor braiding to identify Res_f(Ext_f(P_j) tensor_S N) with P_j tensor_R Res_f N. The naturality equation of the cited statement and the two braiding naturality equations prove compatibility with every differential. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents builds the chain isomorphism.

Restriction preserves homology. Compose restriction of Q.isoLeftDerivedObj with the inverse of (K.sc i).mapHomologyIso, homology of the chain isomorphism, and the inverse of P.isoLeftDerivedObj. This gives the stated isomorphism for all i, including zero.

theorem nonempty_flat_scalar_extension_tor_iso
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.Flat)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u} R) (N : ModuleCat.{u} S) (i : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((restrictScalars f).obj
      (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} S) i).obj ((extendScalars f).obj L)).obj N) ≅
      (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj L).obj ((restrictScalars f).obj N)))
